description: This file defines a template class 'logger_impl' for logging functionality, including level control, context setting, and hex dump size configuration. It also provides type traits, logger type aliases, and a basic logger with predefined levels and string conversion functions.

classes.name: logger_impl
classes.description: Template class providing core logging functionalities, including level management, context setting, and thread safety.

methods.name: set_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level, enabling or disabling channels based on the level.

methods.name: set_context
methods.description: Sets context values for all channels; not thread-safe.

methods.name: set_hex_dump_max_size
methods.description: Sets maximum size for hex dump output for all channels.
